description: The one-shot call that creates the first team and its first admin on a freshly deployed hub, before any member is able to log in.
auth: The X-Bootstrap-Token header must equal the Worker secret BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN

headers.X-Bootstrap-Token: <the value stored as the BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN secret>

notes: The endpoint only accepts a call while the teams table is empty; a second call answers 409 CONFLICT with the existing team id, so the first success is what retires it and no separate switch exists.

github_username is resolved through the GitHub API into the numeric github_user_id and display name the members table requires, so the admin can log in immediately; a login GitHub does not know answers 404 USER_NOT_FOUND.
The member is written as role admin with status active, which is what lets it reach every admin endpoint without an invite.
A hub without the BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN secret answers 503 NOT_CONFIGURED; a missing or different header answers 401 UNAUTHORIZED.
The team and its member are written in one D1 batch, so a hub never holds a team whose admin row is missing.
